scope: Independent exact source/diff, owning cleanup and four focused regression case re-review; no compilation, tests, fixture calls or tracked writes

checks.property: Actual child and original typed constructor error
checks.evidence: Each injected failpoint follows actual Child spawn, Self ownership and pipe extraction; new() remains private no-fault/no-observer. catch_unwind rejects a secondary constructor/Drop panic and matches the exact fixed constructor Err. checks.property: Real reaping and successful created-worker joins

Tests require the exact expected worker set, successful created joins, empty handle set and actual Node reap.

checks.property: Force/deadline failures remain visible to regression
checks.evidence: Local forced state and direct first/second phase deadline checks are included in the private observation. All four tests require forced=false and both deadline flags=false independently of the sticky expected Err, so the former masked-error counterexamples no longer satisfy them.

The same existing 15-second ACK/natural-exit phase and second 15-second reap/worker phase remain. Missing-worker, ACK, frame, browser identity, exit/outcome and worker failures still produce the same sticky Result. The private return type transports observations; it adds no owner, loop, wait, retry or success fallback.

checks.property: Cached Err and deliberate Drop failure floor
checks.evidence: close caches the original Result before emitting one observation. Repeated close must return that Err with no new observation. Normal Drop must panic with that fixed original reason; channel disconnection after Drop proves observation owner disposal. No extra cleanup notification/budget is accepted.

One fixture-only enum, one observation struct and optional private mpsc sender. One nonblocking-to-the-owner unbounded send occurs only after actual cleanup and result caching. No public/config/environment/protocol/production surface or general observer framework is added.

checks.property: Honest browser custody and simulation boundaries
checks.evidence: Manifest, comments and fixed output state injected setup failure is not empirical OS exhaustion. Browser custody remains UNKNOWN in partial and ready-then-failed-close cases; Node reaping, worker joins and phase success do not prove Chromium group absence or temp-file deletion. No new raw ID/error/business payload output is added.
